recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure stands on a foggy skyscraper rooftop overlooking a dense city at sunset, while a massive futuristic blimp with glowing green digital displays floats overhead and alien figures emerge from the mist.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy between the rooftop subject and the overhead blimp
Contrast between the warm orange sunset horizon and the cool purple-blue foreground
Surreal integration of extraterrestrial elements into a realistic urban environment
Scale disparity between the human subject and the massive aerial vessel
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the blimp
Glowing green neon accents on the blimp and alien eyes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure centered in the lower-middle ground, approximately one-third the height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure acts as the primary anchor, while the blimp serves as a secondary massive visual weight in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure, moves upward to the glowing blimp, then follows the horizon line across the city before settling on the alien figures in the mist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky and distant cityscape provide open areas to balance the heavy architectural framing on the left and right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and indigo tones define the shadows, fog, and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow represent the sunset horizon and building lights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric green for the blimp's digital screen and alien eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the horizon and neon elements against desaturated, dark urban textures.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright reds or primary blues
Maintain a dark, moody value range

letterConstructionRules: Digital glitch or scan-line texture applied to the fill
Perspective distortion to match the curve of the blimp
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into a glowing green HUD-style frame

composition.rotation: Slightly angled to match blimp orientation

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face used for environmental integration.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical aesthetic of the blimp text
Provides a similar geometric, sci-fi feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic wide shot of a man in a silver jacket standing on a dark rooftop. The rooftop is covered in thick purple mist. In the background, a sunset city skyline with a space needle. A massive dark blimp floats in the upper sky. Small green-eyed alien heads peek out from the mist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a wide, bold sans-serif text onto the side of the blimp. Warp the text to follow the blimp's curvature. Add a bright green neon glow effect and horizontal scan-line textures to the text to make it look like a digital screen.

verificationChecks: Is the text warped to the blimp's surface?
Does the green glow affect the surrounding hull?
Is the sunset horizon properly reflected in the building windows?

adjustableVariables: Number of alien figures in the background
Complexity of the blimp's digital HUD
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Proprietary logos or branding on clothing
Exact building silhouettes of the city

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of the subject into the atmospheric lighting
Convincing perspective on the blimp text
avoid: Hard edges between the mist and the rooftop

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent light direction from the sunset
Ensure the blimp feels massive through scale and atmospheric perspective
Verify the green glow doesn't overpower the central subject
Confirm the mist has a soft, volumetric quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + atmospheric rooftop + massive aerial vehicle + neon digital display + surreal background elements + dual-tone color grading.
